name: 19551 · Robesonia, PA
findings: ZIP 19551 (Robesonia) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19551 (Robesonia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
58% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19551 (Robesonia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.2 times the typical level).
